title: Deep Learning-Based Welding Process Optimization and Adaptive Control Method for Welding Robots
authors: Hai-Tao Li, Tian Xiao-long, Peng Zhang, Feng Yang, Tao Wang, Ci-En Li
abstract: GMAW (gas metal arc welding) robots are frequently used in contemporary manufacturing as they offer high levels of productivity, repeatable process stability and less need for manual labour. However, even today practical robotic welding is often based upon manual design, teaching and offline programming. Welding parameters and trajectories must be redesigned whenever the workpiece, joint geometries or assembly conditions change. Furthermore, during welding, changes to the weld-seam state caused by machining error, assembly deviation and cyclic heat input result in weld parameters planned for ideal conditions becoming inadequate and the risk of incomplete fusion, porosity, cracking, slag inclusions and unstable backside formations greatly increased. In this paper a method based on deep learning is presented to provide optimization of the welding process and adaptive control for GMAW robots. This method consists of integrated quality grade oriented process planning; site-specifically improved multi-objective parameter optimization; semi-supervised semantic segmentation for the perception of weld seams and molten pools and their associated spatter suppression through neural networks predicting weld formation; and fuzzy adaptive control logic. Butt joints of Q235 carbon structural steel were tested experimentally and a response surface model was developed linking welding current, welding speed, torch angle and nozzle height to geometric properties of the welds.

infographic.key_insight: An integrated deep learning and adaptive control method aims to help GMAW robots adjust welding parameters as joint geometry and seam conditions change.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Adaptive welding could reduce manual reprogramming and help maintain weld quality despite assembly deviations and heat-induced changes.
method: Quality-grade-oriented planning with site-specific multi-objective parameter optimization.
Semi-supervised seam and molten-pool segmentation, plus neural-network weld-formation prediction for spatter suppression.
Fuzzy adaptive control to adjust the welding process.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experiments used Q235 steel butt joints and developed a response surface model relating current, welding speed, torch angle and nozzle height to weld geometry; the abstract reports no quantitative performance gains.
infographic.watch_item: Generalization beyond Q235 steel butt joints and robustness under production conditions require further validation.
infographic.paper_title: Deep Learning-Based Welding Process Optimization and Adaptive Control Method for Welding Robots

zh-Hans.title: 基于深度学习的焊接机器人焊接工艺优化与自适应控制方法
zh-Hans.abstract: GMAW（熔化极气体保护电弧焊）机器人因其生产效率高、工艺稳定性可重复且对人工劳动的需求较少，在现代制造业中得到广泛应用。然而，即使在今天，实际机器人焊接仍往往依赖人工设计、示教和离线编程。每当工件、接头几何形状或装配条件发生变化时，都必须重新设计焊接参数和轨迹。此外，在焊接过程中，加工误差、装配偏差和周期性热输入引起的焊缝状态变化，会使针对理想条件规划的焊接参数不再适用，并大幅增加未熔合、气孔、裂纹、夹渣及背面成形不稳定的风险。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的方法，用于GMAW机器人的焊接工艺优化与自适应控制。该方法集成了面向质量等级的工艺规划、针对现场情况改进的多目标参数优化、用于焊缝和熔池感知的半监督语义分割及通过预测焊缝成形的神经网络实现的相关飞溅抑制，以及模糊自适应控制逻辑。研究对Q235碳素结构钢对接接头进行了试验，并建立了响应面模型，将焊接电流、焊接速度、焊枪角度和喷嘴高度与焊缝几何特征关联起来。

infographic.key_insight: 一种集成深度学习与自适应控制的方法，旨在帮助GMAW机器人在接头几何形状和焊缝状态发生变化时调整焊接参数。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 自适应焊接有望减少人工重新编程，并有助于在存在装配偏差和热致变化的情况下保持焊缝质量。
method: 面向质量等级的规划，结合针对现场情况的多目标参数优化。
对焊缝和熔池进行半监督分割，并利用神经网络预测焊缝成形，以抑制飞溅。
采用模糊自适应控制来调整焊接过程。
infographic.evidence_signal: 试验采用Q235钢对接接头，并建立了将电流、焊接速度、焊枪角度和喷嘴高度与焊缝几何形状关联起来的响应面模型；摘要未报告定量的性能提升。
infographic.watch_item: 该方法在Q235钢对接接头以外的泛化能力，以及在生产条件下的鲁棒性，仍需进一步验证。

title: Recent Advances in Friction Stir Welding of Aluminum Alloys and Aluminum Metal Matrix Composites: Process Developments, Microstructural Evolution, and Mechanical Performance
authors: Shailesh S. Parkhe, Javed Sikandar Shaikh, Amit Malgol, Mayur Jayant Gitay, Aniket Akhade, Aqleem Siddiqui
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) is an established solid-state joining process for aluminium alloys and aluminium metal matrix composites (Al-MMCs), offering advantages over conventional fusion welding by reducing melting-related defects, distortion, and thermal degradation. However, weld quality and mechanical performance are governed by the coupled effects of process parameters, tool characteristics, thermal conditions, material flow, and, in Al-MMCs, reinforcement behaviour. Although several recent reviews have examined individual aspects of FSW, a comprehensive comparative synthesis linking process parameters and thermal/deformation mechanisms with microstructural evolution, defect formation, tool wear, and mechanical performance across conventional and advanced FSW of both aluminium alloys and Al-MMCs remains limited. This review addresses this gap by critically examining conventional FSW and selected advanced variants, including underwater/submerged FSW, vibration- and ultrasonic-assisted FSW, laser-assisted FSW, and electrical current-assisted FSW, from an integrated process–structure–property perspective. The central contribution of this review is a mechanism-oriented comparative framework that identifies how the different FSW approaches modify heat generation, heat dissipation, material plasticization, and material flow, and how these changes subsequently influence microstructure, defects, tool wear, residual stress, and mechanical performance. Particular emphasis is placed on rotational speed, traverse speed, cooling conditions, tool geometry and material, external energy assistance, dynamic recrystallization, reinforcement redistribution, and reinforcement–tool interactions. The comparison demonstrates that the effectiveness of each FSW variant is strongly dependent on the material system and processing conditions, limiting the applicability of universal process guidelines. For Al-MMCs, reinforcement fraction, particle size and distribution, particle fragmentation or clustering, and tool–reinforcement interactions introduce additional challenges compared with conventional aluminium alloys. Despite significant advances, challenges remain in controlling thermal conditions, achieving uniform material flow, detecting internal defects, minimizing tool wear, and translating advanced FSW variants from laboratory-scale investigations to industrial production. Future research should therefore focus on systematic comparative studies, in-process monitoring, data-driven optimization, sustainable manufacturing, and scalable process development to improve the reliability and industrial applicability of FSW for aluminium alloys and Al-MMCs.

infographic.key_insight: FSW variants alter heat and material flow, linking processing conditions to microstructure and mechanical performance in aluminium alloys and composites.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Weld design should match tool characteristics, cooling and energy assistance to the alloy or composite reinforcement rather than rely on universal settings.
method: Critically review conventional, submerged, vibration/ultrasonic-, laser- and electrical current-assisted FSW.
Compare heat generation, cooling, plasticization and material-flow mechanisms.
Link mechanisms to recrystallization, reinforcement redistribution, defects, tool wear and mechanical performance.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports a comparative literature synthesis, but provides no quantitative performance gains or validation metrics.
infographic.watch_item: In aluminium composites, reinforcement fraction, particle size and clustering complicate process selection and tool-wear control.
infographic.paper_title: Recent Advances in Friction Stir Welding of Aluminum Alloys and Aluminum Metal Matrix Composites: Process Developments, Microstructural Evolution, and Mechanical Performance

zh-Hans.title: 铝合金及铝基金属基复合材料搅拌摩擦焊的最新进展：工艺发展、微观组织演变与力学性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）是一种成熟的固相连接工艺，适用于铝合金及铝基金属基复合材料（Al-MMCs）。与传统熔焊相比，该工艺可减少与熔化相关的缺陷、变形和热致性能退化。然而，焊接质量和力学性能受工艺参数、搅拌工具特征、热条件、材料流动以及Al-MMCs中增强相行为的耦合影响。尽管近期已有多篇综述探讨了FSW的各个方面，但针对铝合金及Al-MMCs的常规和先进FSW工艺，将工艺参数及热与变形机制同微观组织演变、缺陷形成、工具磨损及力学性能联系起来的全面比较性综合分析仍然有限。本综述从工艺—组织—性能一体化视角出发，通过批判性审视常规FSW及若干先进变体来填补这一空白，所涵盖的变体包括水下/浸没式FSW、振动辅助与超声辅助FSW、激光辅助FSW以及电流辅助FSW。本综述的核心贡献在于提出一个以机制为导向的比较框架，阐明不同FSW方法如何改变产热、散热、材料塑化及材料流动，以及这些变化随后如何影响微观组织、缺陷、工具磨损、残余应力和力学性能。重点关注转速、焊接行进速度、冷却条件、工具几何形状与材料、外部能量辅助、动态再结晶、增强相再分布以及增强相与工具之间的相互作用。比较表明，各类FSW变体的有效性高度依赖于材料体系和加工条件，因此通用工艺指南的适用性受到限制。对于Al-MMCs，增强相含量、颗粒尺寸及分布、颗粒破碎或团聚以及工具与增强相之间的相互作用，使其相较于常规铝合金面临更多挑战。尽管已取得显著进展，但在控制热条件、实现均匀材料流动、检测内部缺陷、尽量减少工具磨损以及将先进FSW变体从实验室规模研究转化为工业生产等方面，仍存在挑战。因此，未来研究应重点开展系统性比较研究、过程在线监测、数据驱动优化、可持续制造及可规模化工艺开发，以提高铝合金及Al-MMCs搅拌摩擦焊的可靠性和工业适用性。

infographic.key_insight: FSW变体通过改变热流与材料流动，将铝合金及复合材料的加工条件与微观组织和力学性能联系起来。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 焊接设计应根据合金或复合材料增强相的特征，匹配搅拌工具特征、冷却条件和能量辅助方式，而非依赖通用参数设置。
method: 批判性审视常规FSW、浸没式FSW、振动/超声辅助FSW、激光辅助FSW及电流辅助FSW。
比较产热、冷却、塑化及材料流动机制。
将这些机制与再结晶、增强相再分布、缺陷、工具磨损及力学性能联系起来。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了对文献的比较性综合分析，但未提供量化的性能提升数据或验证指标。
infographic.watch_item: 在铝基复合材料中，增强相含量、颗粒尺寸及团聚使工艺选择和工具磨损控制更加复杂。

title: ANALYSIS OF FACTORS AFFECTING WELD QUALITY IN INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURING: AN ISHIKAWA-BASED APPROACH
authors: Fernando César Zanco, Vinicius Pereira Campos, Undergraduate Student In Mechanical Engineering, Willian Ricardo Dias da Silva, Mario Vinicio Garcia, Roberto Moraes Cruz
abstract: Welding quality is a critical factor in industrial equipment manufacturing, directly influencing structural integrity, operational reliability, and component safety. However, welding discontinuities may result from the interaction of technical, operational, organizational, and environmental factors, requiring integrated preventive quality management approaches. This study aims to analyze the main factors influencing weld quality in industrial equipment manufacturing, systematically classifying potential causes of discontinuities and identifying preventive measures based on technical standards. The research adopts a qualitative, exploratory, and descriptive approach, supported by a literature review and documentary analysis of welding quality standards, particularly the ABNT NBR ISO 3834 series. The Ishikawa Diagram, structured according to the 6M framework, was employed to classify potential causes into Method, Machine, Material, Manpower, Measurement, and Environment. The findings identified five major welding discontinuities: porosity, cracks, lack of fusion, incomplete penetration, and undercut. The analysis indicates that these discontinuities may arise from interconnected process conditions, emphasizing the importance of standardized procedures, equipment monitoring, appropriate material handling, personnel qualification, and systematic inspection. The study contributes an integrated analytical framework linking welding discontinuities, potential causal factors, and preventive control measures. It concludes that combining technical standardization with quality management tools may support preventive decision-making and continuous improvement in industrial welding processes, although empirical validation remains necessary.

infographic.key_insight: An Ishikawa 6M framework links five major welding discontinuities to interconnected process factors and preventive controls.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework can guide welding quality management to support structural integrity, equipment reliability, and component safety.
method: Qualitative, exploratory literature review and documentary analysis.
Review of welding quality standards, particularly ABNT NBR ISO 3834.
Ishikawa classification across Method, Machine, Material, Manpower, Measurement, and Environment.
infographic.evidence_signal: The review identified porosity, cracks, lack of fusion, incomplete penetration, and undercut, but the abstract reports no empirical validation or quantitative performance evaluation.
infographic.watch_item: Validate the proposed cause–control relationships in production before assuming reductions in welding discontinuities.
infographic.paper_title: ANALYSIS OF FACTORS AFFECTING WELD QUALITY IN INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURING: AN ISHIKAWA-BASED APPROACH

zh-Hans.title: 工业设备制造中影响焊接质量的因素分析：基于石川图的方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 焊接质量是工业设备制造中的关键因素，直接影响结构完整性、运行可靠性和部件安全性。然而，焊接不连续性可能由技术、操作、组织和环境因素相互作用而产生，因此需要采用综合性的预防性质量管理方法。本研究旨在分析工业设备制造中影响焊接质量的主要因素，系统地对不连续性的潜在成因进行分类，并依据技术标准确定预防措施。研究采用定性、探索性和描述性方法，以文献综述和对焊接质量标准的文献资料分析为支撑，重点关注 ABNT NBR ISO 3834 系列标准。研究采用按 6M 框架构建的石川图，将潜在成因分为方法、机器、材料、人员、测量和环境六类。研究结果识别出五种主要焊接不连续性：气孔、裂纹、未熔合、未焊透和咬边。分析表明，这些不连续性可能源于相互关联的工艺条件，凸显了标准化规程、设备监测、妥善的材料处理、人员资质和系统性检验的重要性。本研究提出了一个综合分析框架，将焊接不连续性、潜在致因因素和预防性控制措施联系起来。研究认为，将技术标准化与质量管理工具相结合，可能有助于工业焊接过程中的预防性决策和持续改进，但仍需进行实证验证。

infographic.key_insight: 石川图 6M 框架将五种主要焊接不连续性与相互关联的工艺因素及预防性控制措施联系起来。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架可指导焊接质量管理，以支持结构完整性、设备可靠性和部件安全性。

审查焊接质量标准，重点关注 ABNT NBR ISO 3834。
采用石川图，按方法、机器、材料、人员、测量和环境进行分类。
infographic.evidence_signal: 综述识别出气孔、裂纹、未熔合、未焊透和咬边，但摘要未报告实证验证或定量性能评估。
infographic.watch_item: 在认定焊接不连续性会减少之前，应在生产中验证所提出的成因与控制措施之间的关系。

title: Study on the transition behavior and forming process of oscillating laser double-wire welding of aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaoxu Li, Quanda Zhang, Dandan Zhao, Zizhi Liu, Wenhao Huang
abstract: To achieve high-quality and high-stability weld formation in aluminum alloys, this study investigates the dynamic evolution of the molten pool and droplet transfer behavior during oscillating laser double-wire welding. Particular emphasis is placed on the coupled effects of process parameters—including laser power, laser oscillation parameters (frequency, amplitude, and trajectory), and wire feeding speed—on molten-pool morphology and weld quality. By employing high-speed imaging technology, the surface flow of the molten pool, droplet transfer, and metal filling behavior were captured in real time, revealing the influence of oscillation parameters on the stability of weld formation. Research indicates that different laser oscillation patterns—such as circular, ∞-shaped, and figure-eight trajectories—significantly modify the spatial distribution and fluctuation period of heat-source energy within the molten pool, thereby influencing the pool’s responsiveness to external energy input and material feed. A well-designed oscillation trajectory can effectively enhance convective flow within the molten pool and improve the stability of droplet transfer. This research further aims to construct a mapping relationship between droplet transfer and molten-pool response under various process parameters, and to establish a multifactor coupled model of “energy input–molten pool behavior-forming quality” providing both theoretical support and experimental evidence for high-precision control and process optimization in oscillating laser double-wire welding.

infographic.key_insight: Laser oscillation trajectory shapes molten-pool energy distribution and flow, with suitable paths improving droplet-transfer stability in aluminum double-wire welding.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coordinating laser power, oscillation settings, and wire feed could support more stable weld formation and precise process control.
method: Investigate coupled effects of laser power, oscillation parameters, and wire feeding speed.
Use high-speed imaging to observe molten-pool flow, droplet transfer, and metal filling.
Compare circular, ∞-shaped, and figure-eight trajectories to inform an energy–pool behavior–weld quality model.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports real-time imaging observations and qualitative trajectory-dependent changes, but provides no numerical quality metrics or validation results.
infographic.watch_item: The coupled model is presented as an aim; no AI method or validated optimization framework is described in the abstract.
infographic.paper_title: Study on the transition behavior and forming process of oscillating laser double-wire welding of aluminum alloy

zh-Hans.title: 铝合金振荡激光双丝焊接过渡行为与成形过程研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 为实现铝合金焊缝的高质量、高稳定性成形，本研究考察了振荡激光双丝焊接过程中熔池的动态演化与熔滴过渡行为，重点关注激光功率、激光振荡参数（频率、振幅和轨迹）以及送丝速度等工艺参数对熔池形貌与焊缝质量的耦合影响。采用高速成像技术，实时捕捉熔池表面流动、熔滴过渡及金属填充行为，揭示振荡参数对焊缝成形稳定性的影响。研究表明，圆形、∞形和8字形等不同激光振荡轨迹会显著改变熔池内热源能量的空间分布与波动周期，进而影响熔池对外部能量输入和材料供给的响应特性。合理设计的振荡轨迹可有效增强熔池内的对流流动，提高熔滴过渡的稳定性。本研究还旨在构建不同工艺参数下熔滴过渡与熔池响应之间的映射关系，并建立“能量输入—熔池行为—成形质量”多因素耦合模型，为振荡激光双丝焊接的高精度控制与工艺优化提供理论支撑和实验证据。

infographic.key_insight: 激光振荡轨迹影响熔池能量分布与流动，适宜的轨迹可提高铝合金双丝焊接中熔滴过渡的稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 协同调控激光功率、振荡参数和送丝速度，有望实现更稳定的焊缝成形与精确的工艺控制。
method: 研究激光功率、振荡参数和送丝速度的耦合影响。
采用高速成像技术观察熔池流动、熔滴过渡和金属填充行为。
比较圆形、∞形和8字形轨迹，为构建能量—熔池行为—焊缝质量模型提供依据。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了实时成像观测结果，以及随轨迹变化而出现的定性差异，但未提供数值化质量指标或验证结果。

title: Welding Characteristics of Type XM-19 Stainless Steel
authors: Hye-Eun Jeong, Gitae Park, Sangwoo Song, Eun−Joon Chun, Yongjoon Kang
abstract: Type XM-19 stainless steel is a potential structural material for pressure vessel applications in small modular reactors (SMRs). In this study, the welding characteristics of XM-19 stainless steel were investigated using autogenous gas tungsten arc welding (GTAW) and fiber laser welding. The weld morphology, solidification behavior, and microstructure were evaluated using microscopy and solidification-mode prediction. Both GTAW and laser welds exhibited A-mode solidification under all investigated welding conditions; the dominant solidification morphology differed between the two welding processes. Additionally, Z-phase was observed in the interdendritic regions of both arc and laser welds.

infographic.key_insight: XM-19 stainless steel welds showed A-mode solidification and interdendritic Z-phase in both GTAW and fiber laser welding, but their dominant solidification morphologies differed.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These findings inform welding-process development for XM-19 as a potential structural material for small modular reactor pressure vessels.
method: Produced autogenous GTAW and fiber laser welds.
Examined weld morphology and microstructure using microscopy.
Evaluated solidification behavior using solidification-mode prediction.
infographic.evidence_signal: Across all investigated welding conditions, both processes exhibited A-mode solidification, and microscopy identified Z-phase in interdendritic regions.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract reports no mechanical-property or corrosion testing, so pressure-vessel service suitability remains unverified.
infographic.paper_title: Welding Characteristics of Type XM-19 Stainless Steel

zh-Hans.title: XM-19型不锈钢的焊接特性
zh-Hans.abstract: XM-19型不锈钢是小型模块化反应堆（SMRs）压力容器应用的潜在结构材料。本研究采用自熔钨极气体保护电弧焊（GTAW）和光纤激光焊，研究了XM-19不锈钢的焊接特性。通过显微观察和凝固模式预测，评估了焊缝形貌、凝固行为及微观组织。在所有研究的焊接条件下，GTAW焊缝和激光焊缝均表现出A模式凝固；两种焊接工艺的主导凝固形貌有所不同。此外，在电弧焊缝和激光焊缝的枝晶间区域均观察到了Z相。

infographic.key_insight: 在GTAW和光纤激光焊中，XM-19不锈钢焊缝均表现出A模式凝固，且枝晶间均存在Z相，但其主导凝固形貌有所不同。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些发现为XM-19作为小型模块化反应堆压力容器潜在结构材料的焊接工艺开发提供了参考。
method: 采用自熔GTAW和光纤激光焊制备焊缝。

title: High-Strength Steels and Welding Filler Metals for Small Modular Reactor Pressure Vessels
authors: Yongjoon Kang, Jungmin Kim, Gitae Park, Chang-Young Oh, Sangwoo Song
abstract: This paper reviews SA-508 Grade 3 Class 2 low-alloy steel and Type XM-19 austenitic stainless steel as high-strength candidate materials for SMR pressure vessels, covering their material specifications and application status, with particular emphasis on filler metal development. For SA-508 Grade 3 Class 2, the key challenges include developing high-strength filler metals and evaluating the neutron irradiation embrittlement behavior of the base metal and weld metal for beltline applications. For Type XM-19, the establishment of manufacturing technologies for large forgings is needed for its application to nuclear pressure vessels. Although a dedicated filler metal is available, further verification of weld metal performance under reactor operating conditions is necessary, while optimization of the filler metal composition may be required.

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为一种连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究结合计算与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行了全面的预测研究，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，模拟不同转速、焊接速度及底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。利用实验数据对CEL数值模型进行了验证，结果表明，该模型在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面与实验结果具有很高的一致性。结果显示，底面预热能够有效减小温度梯度，并稳定垂直力波动。定量而言，60 °C的底面预热将峰值下压力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并将峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C提高至约100 °C，从而减小了厚度方向的温度梯度，并使轴向力分布趋于稳定。同时，使用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，其R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明模型在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN组合框架能够快速生成工艺图谱，标示存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。其中，最优条件为1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C预热；在1000 rpm且不预热的条件下，由于形成虫孔缺陷，焊接性较差。这些发现为制备性能可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了计算建模与机器学习的集成如何实现高效优化，为深入理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持该技术在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

title: Phase Evolution and Structure–Property Relationships of Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 Coatings with Low GFA Produced by Atmospheric Plasma Spraying
authors: Inez Kredowska, Wirginia Pilarczyk, Aleksandra Małachowska, Paweł Sokołowski, Katarzyna Młynarek-Żak, Paweł M. Nuckowski
abstract: The phase evolution of low-glass-forming-ability (low-GFA) Fe-Zr-Si alloys under atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) conditions remains insufficiently understood. In the present study, Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1 coatings were deposited by APS in order to investigate the influence of spray distance on microstructural development and structure–property relationships. Despite the rapid solidification conditions associated with APS, all coatings exhibited predominantly crystalline multiphase microstructures composed of α-Fe(Si) and Fe-Zr intermetallic phases, with no detectable amorphous fraction in the XRD patterns. The coatings developed a characteristic lamellar morphology with porosity ranging from 2.2 to 4.9%, strongly dependent on spray distance and particle thermal history. Increasing spray distance promoted higher hardness and improved wear resistance but simultaneously deteriorated corrosion resistance due to increased porosity and interlamellar defect population. Among the investigated conditions, the coating deposited at 90 mm exhibited the most favourable balance of hardness, wear resistance, and electrochemical behaviour owing to its relatively dense and cohesive microstructure. The results demonstrate that phase evolution in low-GFA Fe-Zr-Si-Cu alloys processed by APS is governed not only by rapid cooling rates but also by splat-based solidification, repeated thermal cycling, and heterogeneous nucleation during coating build-up.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂制备的低玻璃形成能力（GFA）Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1涂层的相演变与结构–性能关系
zh-Hans.abstract: 目前，对低玻璃形成能力（低GFA）Fe-Zr-Si合金在大气等离子喷涂（APS）条件下的相演变仍缺乏充分理解。本研究采用APS沉积Fe79Zr6Si14Cu1涂层，以考察喷涂距离对微观组织演化及结构–性能关系的影响。尽管APS具有快速凝固条件，所有涂层均呈现以晶态为主的多相微观组织，由α-Fe(Si)和Fe-Zr金属间化合物相组成，XRD图谱中未检测到非晶相。涂层形成了典型的层片状形貌，孔隙率为2.2%至4.9%，且强烈依赖于喷涂距离和颗粒热历史。增大喷涂距离可提高硬度并改善耐磨性，但同时因孔隙率升高及层片间缺陷增多而降低耐腐蚀性。在所研究的条件中，喷涂距离为90 mm时沉积的涂层凭借其相对致密且结合良好的微观组织，在硬度、耐磨性和电化学行为之间表现出最优的综合平衡。结果表明，经APS加工的低GFA Fe-Zr-Si-Cu合金的相演变不仅受快速冷却速率支配，还受到涂层逐层构建过程中扁平粒子凝固、反复热循环及异质形核的影响。

title: Microstructure and Surface Performance of Detonation Gun Sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY Coatings on Al 6061-T6 Substrate for Structural Applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should match the dominant damage mode: NiCrAlY for hardness and corrosion protection, or 80Ni20Cr for erosion resistance under the tested conditions.

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的Al 6061-T6基体上爆炸喷涂80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷枪（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在Al 6061-T6合金基体上沉积了80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、物相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性及抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与80Ni20Cr相比，NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD分析在80Ni20Cr中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的CrNi相，在NiCrAlY中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的Al₂NiY相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶粒结构。AFM测量表明，NiCrAlY的表面粗糙度在全部三个样品中最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY的硬度约为80Ni20Cr的10倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY的硬度为7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），而80Ni20Cr为780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆的Al 6061基体为708.68 MPa。在3.5 wt% NaCl溶液中的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY的腐蚀电流密度最低，为6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr涂层的腐蚀电流密度为1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY具有超疏水性，而80Ni20Cr具有接近超疏水的特性。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温、3.5 wt% NaCl溶液；单一冲蚀条件为冲击角90°、速度40 m/s、持续时间5 min），NiCrAlY表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性能，而80Ni20Cr表现出更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

title: A Review of Post-weld Inspection Technology
authors: Siqi Liu
abstract: Welding robots are now extensively used in shipbuilding, automobile, and aviation industries. Defects are prone to occur after welding, and traditional non-destructive testing like ultrasonic and radiographic testing, depend on manual judgement, resulting in detection lag and difficulty in achieving online closed-loop control on production lines. This paper focuses on robot-mounted vision-based post-weld inspection, dividing the techniques into non-destructive and destructive testing. It outlines a three-level processing paradigm for vision-based inspection: low-level preprocessing, mid-level defect recognition and segmentation, and high-level quality diagnosis. The paper systematically summarizes three deep-learning technical routes: defect recognition and classification, 3D geometric measurement of weld seams, and multimodal temporal intelligent diagnosis. It also compares the application characteristics and applicable scenarios of mainstream models such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), You Only Look Once (YOLO), U-Net, and Detection Transformer (DETR). Various interference factors in industrial environments are analyzed. Finally, future technical directions are discussed in four key aspects, providing a comprehensive theoretical reference for the development of intelligent welding inspection algorithms and the engineering integration of robotic systems.

zh-Hans.title: 焊后检测技术综述
zh-Hans.abstract: 焊接机器人现已广泛应用于造船、汽车和航空工业。焊后易出现缺陷，而超声检测和射线检测等传统无损检测依赖人工判断，导致检测滞后，且难以在生产线上实现在线闭环控制。本文聚焦于机器人搭载的视觉焊后检测，将检测技术分为无损检测和破坏性检测，并概述了视觉检测的三级处理范式：低层预处理、中层缺陷识别与分割，以及高层质量诊断。本文系统总结了三条深度学习技术路线：缺陷识别与分类、焊缝三维几何测量，以及多模态时序智能诊断。同时，比较了卷积神经网络（CNNs）、You Only Look Once（YOLO）、U-Net和Detection Transformer（DETR）等主流模型的应用特点与适用场景，并分析了工业环境中的各种干扰因素。最后，从四个关键方面讨论了未来技术方向，为智能焊接检测算法的开发和机器人系统的工程集成提供全面的理论参考。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Among four WC-10Co-4Cr thermal-spray coatings, HVAF delivered the lowest measured wear rate and best corrosion resistance, while HVOF had the highest hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: HVAF is a promising coating route for 304 stainless steel components requiring combined wear and corrosion protection.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速火焰喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性与耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速火焰喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层，并系统研究和比较了这些涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能及耐腐蚀性。结果表明，APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体，因此这三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更佳。耐腐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 VSCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）和最大的腐蚀电阻（20438.5 Ω）。APS涂层的耐腐蚀性在这四种涂层中最差。

title: Custom-Designed Carbosilane-Based Reactive Surfactants for Surface Hydrophobization─AFM, Raman Microscopy, and XPS Investigations
authors: Sylwia Ronka, Łukasz Lamch, M. Kuchowicz, R. Szukiewicz, Przemysław Szklarz, Krzysztof Gawarecki
abstract: Abstract The reactive carbosilane cationic surfactant (SK) has been studied for glass surface hydrophobization by blending with oligodimethylsiloxane derivatives, comprising epoxide (EO) and amine/alkoxyl motifs (AO), and deposition using three different approaches: spray, spin, and dip coating. Our contribution comprises the synthesis and structure characterization of a surfactant (1H NMR, FT-IR and Raman spectroscopies), the optimization studies for the layer deposition by tuning the chosen parameters and compositions, as well as the determination of contact angles and surface energies. The crucial roles of the layer composition and the deposition methodology were carefully investigated, especially in terms of the reactivity of SK with siloxane derivatives and glass surfaces. The experiments were supported by the calculation of solubility parameters (δ) and the dispersion (δD), polar (δP), and hydrogen bonding (δH, including its splitting into donor (δHD) and acceptor (δHA) counterparts) components utilizing HSPiP software, showing the possibility of appropriate component blending. The layer structure and morphology were studied via atomic force microscopy (AFM) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analyses with Ar+ sputtering as well as in-depth Raman microscopy. It was demonstrated that spray coating was an inappropriate method since it provided an extremely rough layer, while dip coating provided a deposit of limited stability due to the presence of separated SK deposits. The optimal system comprised SK combined with AO by a spin-coating approach, enabling both surface hydrophobization and the formation of a stable, chemically attached layer on the glass surface.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Matching reactive blend chemistry with deposition method can improve the stability and surface properties of hydrophobic glass coatings.

Compare spray, spin, and dip coating while tuning composition and deposition parameters.
Assess wettability, surface energy, morphology, and chemistry using contact angles, AFM, XPS, Raman microscopy, and solubility-parameter calculations.

zh-Hans.title: 用于表面疏水化的定制碳硅烷基反应型表面活性剂─AFM、拉曼显微术和XPS研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 通过将反应型碳硅烷阳离子表面活性剂（SK）与含有环氧基团（EO）或胺基/烷氧基结构单元（AO）的低聚二甲基硅氧烷衍生物共混，并采用喷涂、旋涂和浸涂三种不同方法进行沉积，研究了其对玻璃表面的疏水化作用。本研究包括表面活性剂的合成与结构表征（1H NMR、FT-IR和拉曼光谱），通过调节所选参数和组成开展涂层沉积优化研究，以及接触角和表面能的测定。研究仔细考察了涂层组成和沉积方法的关键作用，尤其关注SK与硅氧烷衍生物及玻璃表面的反应性。利用HSPiP软件计算溶解度参数（δ）及其色散（δD）、极性（δP）和氢键（δH，包括进一步分解得到的供体（δHD）和受体（δHA）分量）组分，为实验提供支持，并表明各组分可进行适当共混。通过原子力显微镜（AFM）、结合Ar+溅射的X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析，以及拉曼显微深度分析，研究了涂层的结构和形貌。结果表明，喷涂会形成极其粗糙的涂层，因此并不适用；浸涂则因存在分离的SK沉积物而形成稳定性有限的沉积层。最优体系为采用旋涂法将SK与AO组合使用，既能实现表面疏水化，又能在玻璃表面形成稳定的、以化学方式附着的涂层。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power, welding speed, and current govern molten-pool flow, weld geometry, and arc stability.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These parameter–response trends can guide welding-process optimization for low-expansion Invar tooling used in aerospace composite manufacturing.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool dynamics
High-speed photography of welding behavior
Analysis across laser power, welding speed, and current ranges

infographic.watch_item: The abstract reports trends within limited parameter ranges but provides no quantitative simulation-validation errors or final weld-property measurements.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢的热膨胀系数极低，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料成型模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大导致反冲压力增大，促进熔深和小孔尺寸增大，加剧熔池整体流动，且在高功率下电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，焊接速度提高使热输入降低，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，高焊接速度下电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大增强了电弧力，促进焊缝宽度增大并加剧熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更加稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光–TIG复合焊接中，激光功率、焊接速度和电流共同决定熔池流动、焊缝几何形状及电弧稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些参数–响应趋势可为航空航天复合材料制造用低膨胀Invar模具的焊接工艺优化提供指导。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating performance depends on powder morphology and spray method: detonation spraying favors hardness, while HVOF delivers a dense, uniform coating with low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting the powder and spray process can help tailor wear-resistant machine-part coatings for intensive friction and high loads.
method: Compared detonation-sprayed and HVOF WC–Co–Cr coatings.
Examined powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
Evaluated coating microhardness and tribological properties.

infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not provide test conditions, variability, or wear-rate data, limiting assessment of service-life gains.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF与爆炸喷涂制备的WC–Co–Cr涂层的组织形成及耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了比较分析。研究采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散谱（EDS）分析了原始粉末的形貌以及涂层的微观组织和相组成。结果表明，使用均质、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状组织，且碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆炸喷涂制备的涂层硬度更高（平均显微硬度为1449 HV），而HVOF制备的涂层具有高致密度、均匀的微观组织和低摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。比较分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些发现有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，对强烈摩擦和高载荷条件下的运行尤为重要。

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

infographic.key_insight: A physics-grounded digital-twin prototype combines weld-pool simulation, AI surrogates and robotic control to screen in-space welding strategies before experimental testing.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Fast surrogate predictions could support adaptive welding control for on-orbit assembly and repair, but performance remains simulation-based.
method: Finite-volume thermal model with phase change, effective thermocapillary transport and local pressure; gravity assessed separately.
Gaussian-process and neural-network surrogates evaluated using repeated five-fold cross-validation.

infographic.watch_item: Thermal-vacuum, reduced-gravity and robotic hardware-in-the-loop validation are still needed; gravity does not enter the thermal energy equation.
infographic.paper_title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理的数字孪生降低空间金属连接中机器人焊接的风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 对空间服务、制造与组装日益增长的兴趣，使模块化建造和在轨维修所需的可靠金属连接技术重新受到关注。机器人焊接具有潜力，但对其在低重力和低压条件下运行的特性仍缺乏充分认识，且接近实际飞行条件的试验有限。英国航天局（UK Space Agency）支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发基于物理的数字孪生，以系统性降低工艺风险。本文评估了一种基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积焊接熔池热模型、高斯过程（GP）和神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。该简化模型包含固液相变、等效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界工况中，80 个求解器响应中有 74 个落在 GP 的标称 90% 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，其中包括缩放处理和预测方差计算。在仿真 UR5 的 L 形焊缝研究中，当行进速度在拐角附近降低时，比例控制器相应调整协同调节型焊接电源的设定值。有限体积法重新评估发现，全部 12 个闭环工作点和 12 个开环工作点中的 9 个均位于示例性的 1.0-3.0 mm 根部侧宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试之前使用该框架筛选焊接条件和控制策略。仍需开展热真空、针对性的低重力以及机器人硬件在环研究，以评估模型和控制器。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 快速代理模型预测有望支持在轨组装和维修中的自适应焊接控制，但其性能仍仅基于仿真。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Predicting UTS, weld hardness, and heat-affected zone (HAZ) hardness can support welding process optimization and mechanical performance assessment.
method: Compare a shared-layer multitask neural network with stacking ensemble learning.

infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习在预测焊接应用中的极限抗拉强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和热影响区硬度方面的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测极限抗拉强度（UTS）、焊道硬度和热影响区（HAZ）力学硬度等焊接性能指标，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其模型旨在同时处理多个相互关联的任务。MTL并非为每个任务分别训练模型，而是在任务之间共享表征，使各任务能够利用共同模式，同时保留任务特有的差异。本研究基于同一数据集，比较了多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习这两种先进机器学习技术在预测上述参数方面的表现。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一类特定的多任务学习（MTL）模型，采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时各自具有专用的输出层。这种共享表征使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保留任务专用的输出。两种方法均采用RMSE和R²进行评估，以确定其预测精度和整体有效性。MTNN表现出较强的预测能力，其UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的RMSE分别为0.1288、0.0886和0.1125，对应的R²值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这表明其能够在相互关联的任务中实现良好的泛化。堆叠集成学习在单项任务的预测精度上优于MTL：对于UTS，RMSE为0.0263，R²为0.9863；对于焊缝硬度，两者分别为0.0467和0.9782；对于HAZ硬度，两者分别为0.1109和0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法能够针对特定任务生成高精度预测。这一比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，能够实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成则更适合需要精确、独立预测的情况。两种方法均展现出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，为进一步研究兼具两者优势的混合模型奠定了基础。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习在全部三个焊接预测目标上的表现均优于多任务神经网络，其中极限抗拉强度（UTS）的预测精度提升最大。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 预测UTS、焊缝硬度和热影响区（HAZ）硬度，可为焊接工艺优化和力学性能评估提供支持。
method: 比较共享隐藏层的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习。
使用同一数据集预测UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度。
采用RMSE和R²评估每个预测目标。
infographic.evidence_signal: 堆叠集成学习对UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的预测R²值分别达到0.9863、0.9782和0.8453，而多任务网络的对应值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Dense, fine-lamellar Fe-based amorphous coatings favor long-term corrosion resistance, while increasing humidity reduces their friction coefficient and wear rate.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Detonation-spray parameter control can help produce low-defect protective coatings on Q235 carbon steel, with service humidity influencing wear performance.
method: Deposit Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 steel using varied detonation-spray parameters.
Examine droplet morphology and coating microstructure.
Evaluate long-term corrosion and wear under different humidity conditions using Si3N4 counterballs.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract links higher coating porosity to poorer long-term corrosion resistance and reports decreasing friction coefficients and wear rates with increasing humidity, without numerical results.
infographic.watch_item: Humidity-dependent wear benefits involve Si3N4–water tribochemistry and may not generalize to other counterface materials.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为与摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成微观组织致密的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷越多，其长期耐腐蚀性越低。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层在不同湿度条件下的磨损行为具有重要影响。随着湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率均降低。

infographic.key_insight: 致密的细层片结构铁基非晶涂层有利于提高长期耐腐蚀性，而湿度升高可降低其摩擦系数和磨损率。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制爆炸喷涂参数有助于在Q235碳钢上制备低缺陷防护涂层，而服役环境湿度会影响其磨损性能。
method: 采用不同的爆炸喷涂参数，在Q235钢上沉积铁基非晶涂层。
考察液滴形貌和涂层微观组织。
使用Si3N4对磨球，评估不同湿度条件下的长期腐蚀与磨损行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要将涂层孔隙率较高与长期耐腐蚀性较差联系起来，并报告摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度升高而降低，但未提供数值结果。
infographic.watch_item: 湿度对降低磨损的有利作用涉及Si3N4与水之间的摩擦化学反应，可能不适用于其他对磨材料。
